case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.987 OF 2009, CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS.989-990 OF 2009, CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.986 OF 2009, CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.988 OF 2009, CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 645 OF 2023 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (Crl.) No.5296 of 2012)
summary: Kidnapping for ransom under IPC s.364A; evidence standard beyond reasonable doubt; child witness credibility affirmed; police investigation discrepancies not fatal to prosecution; prolonged incarceration argued for sentence modification; conviction under s.364A upheld as threat to cause death established; appeals partially allowed to abate deceased accused's case.
final_judgment: Criminal Appeal No.987 of 2009 abated for deceased accused; other appeals allowed in part; conviction under s.364A IPC upheld; life imprisonment and fine maintained.
